bihar_raw_news.content: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary on Sunday appealed to financially well-off people and income tax payers to voluntarily give up the benefit of 125 units of free electricity and support the state's development. Also Read 5paisa Capital Wins Major Relief in Income Tax Appeal, Disallowance Cut to Rs 2.87 Crore Speaking at the two-day 'Pataliputra National Youth Parliament 2.0' event, Choudhary said the state government spends around Rs 23,000 crore every year on electricity subsidies. He said the government provides 125 units of free electricity to consumers across all income groups and urged those who can afford to pay their bills to give up the benefit. Education Minister Mithilesh Tiwari , MP Shambhavi Choudhary and Youth Parliament founder Sayan Kunal were among those present at the event . The Chief Minister also highlighted the important role of young people in strengthening democracy and building a developed India. He said Bihar has a rich history of democratic values and that the youth must take responsibility for protecting and promoting them. Recalling India's freedom struggle, Choudhary said the country became independent in 1947 because of the sacrifices of freedom fighters. As India moves towards completing 80 years of Independence, he said people must renew their commitment to democratic values. He also praised Prime Minister Narendra Modi's vision of making India a developed nation by 2047 and said former Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar had made important contributions to the state's development. Referring to the 1974 movement, Choudhary said young people had played a major role in bringing change . He added that today's generations, including Gen Z and Gen Alpha, must also come forward to strengthen democracy. Also Read CBDT Notifies New Rules for Merger of Registered Non-Profit Organisations Under Income Tax Rules 2026 The Chief Minister said quality education and knowledge are the keys to success and prosperity . He also called for organising the Youth Parliament every year to help young people understand democratic processes, constitutional values and their role in nation-building.

bihar_raw_news.content: Agencies Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary urges income-tax payers and wealthy households to give up 125 units of free electricity and support Bihar's development. Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary has urged financially well-off residents and income-tax payers to voluntarily give up their entitlement to 125 units of free electricity , saying the money saved could support the state's development, a TOI report stated. The chief minister made the appeal while addressing the Pataliputra National Youth Parliament-2.0 in Patna on Sunday. He said the Bihar government spends around Rs 23,000 crore every year on electricity subsidies, with the annual subsidy amount ranging between Rs 8,000 and Rs 10,000 per household. Choudhary said the government currently provides 125 units of free electricity to consumers irrespective of their economic background. However, he appealed to those who can afford to pay their electricity bills to voluntarily surrender the benefit. He said financially comfortable households, particularly income-tax payers, should consider giving up the subsidy and contributing towards Bihar's growth. Bihar spends Rs 23,000 crore annually on electricity subsidies The chief minister highlighted the financial commitment involved in providing subsidised electricity to households across the state. According to Choudhary, the government spends approximately Rs 23,000 crore annually on electricity subsidies. The estimated expenditure per household stands at Rs 8,000 to Rs 10,000. The existing arrangement provides 125 units of free electricity to consumers across income groups. Choudhary's appeal, however, was directed at households that have the financial capacity to manage their electricity expenses without government support. He urged income-tax-paying residents and financially well-off families to voluntarily surrender the benefit rather than continue receiving subsidised power. Why Bihar CM is appealing to financially well-off households Choudhary linked his appeal to the larger objective of Bihar's development. He called upon people with the ability to pay their electricity bills to contribute towards the state's progress. The INDIA bloc on Sunday called for the BJP’s ouster from power over the “vote chori” charge, with Congress leader Rahul Gandhi asserting that CEC Gyanesh Kumar will be removed and sent to jail for “treason” in the future, and Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah will not be allowed to escape the law. In a show of strength, prominent leaders of the opposition grouping addressed a rally at Ramlila Maidan against alleged electoral irregularities and voter list revision, and claimed that the BJP formed governments at the Centre and in states with a “stolen” mandate. In a statement, the BJP said Nabin will lead the ‘Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao’ padyatra in Bihar and West Bengal on Monday against the Opposition’s “lies and anarchy”. “Bharatiya Janata Party national president Nitin Nabin will lead two major ‘Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao Padyatras’ in Bihar and West Bengal on Monday as part of the party’s nationwide campaign against the Opposition’s misinformation, disinformation and organised anarchy,” it said. According to the BJP, Nabin’s first padyatra (march) will commence at around 11:00 am from Lajpat Park in Bhagalpur (Bihar) and conclude at Seva Jyoti Chowk at 12:30 pm. “Thereafter, the BJP national president will travel to Kolkata, West Bengal, where the ‘Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao Padyatra’ will commence at 3:00 pm from College Street. The padyatra will conclude at Dharmatala at 5:30 pm,” the party said. “Senior party leaders, state BJP presidents, thousands of dedicated karyakartas and people will participate in these padyatras being organised in Bhagalpur and Kolkata,” it added. The BJP said the party’s campaign is a “movement against the lies, deception, conspiracies and anarchy being spread by a desperate and disillusioned Opposition.” “With the resolve of ‘Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao’, every BJP karyakarta is reaching out to villages and households to expose the Opposition’s false and fabricated narrative and apprise the people of the truth,” it added. bihar_raw_news.title: MP CM Mohan Yadav Directs Ministers, MPs And MLAs To Ensure 100% Property ...
bihar_raw_news.content: Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh): Chief Minister Mohan Yadav, while reviewing the progress of Mukhyamantri Registry Yojana at CM House, said that all ministers, MPs and MLAs should visit their ancestral villages on Dhateras or any village of their choice and personally oversee the completion of 100% property registrations under the scheme. He said that along with owning a plot or house, it is equally important to have valid and permanent revenue documents for the property. These documents establish the owner's legal rights and enable them to buy and sell their property. He directed departmental officials to implement the scheme as a large-scale campaign and ensure that all eligible property owners in the state receive free permanent registration of their land titles at the earliest. The campaign to provide permanent property registration would continue in the coming years as well. Next year, it would also be linked with the 'Year of Youth'. Over 12.87 lakh registrations completed Principal secretary, revenue, E Ramesh Kumar, informed at the meeting that, as of Nov 1, 2026, a total of 12,87,252 properties were registered across the state. Efforts are underway to complete 20 lakh registrations by November 15. MSME minister Chetanya Kashyap, minister of state Narendra Shivaji Patel, chief secretary Ashok Barnwal, additional chief secretary Neeraj Mandloi, secretary and commissioner, public relations, Manish Singh were also present. bihar_raw_news.title: PM Modi Hails Madhya Pradesh's Contribution To Nation's Progress On Foundation Day ...
bihar_raw_news.content: Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh): Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated the people of Madhya Pradesh on the state's foundation day on Sunday. He said people of the state have made remarkable contributions in every field through their talent and enterprise. From agriculture, industry, tourism, education and infrastructure to innovation, the state is achieving new milestones. Along with its all-round development, it is also playing a vital role in building an 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat'. Taking to his X handle, he said that the state is a land of glorious heritage, rich culture and stunning natural beauty. The world-renowned heritage sites here further enhance its historical identity. He wished happiness, peace and prosperity in the lives of the people of the state. PM Modi praises MP's development, welcomes Farmers Welfare Year initiative Prime Minister Narendra Modi has written a letter to Chief Minister Mohan Yadav on Madhya Pradesh Foundation Day on Sunday. He said that he is happy to know that the state government is celebrating the current year as Farmers Welfare Year. Remembering the old days when he used to visit different parts of the state while working for the party organisation, he recalled Kushabhau Thakre's dedication towards the organisation, the vision of former PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee and the public service of Vijayaraje Scindia. Mentioning Mahakal's Ujjain city, the Narmada River and the intellectuality of Raja Bhoj, he said that in past years, the state and Centre have jointly worked on the state's connectivity and infrastructure. bihar_raw_news.title: Nitin Nabin to lead 'Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao Padyatra' in Bihar and West Bengal today
bihar_raw_news.content: N ew Delhi [India], November 2 (ANI): Bharatiya Janata Party national president Nitin Nabin will lead two major 'Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao Padyatras' in Bihar and West Bengal on Monday, as part of the party's nationwide campaign against the Opposition's misinformation, disinformation and organised anarchy. Advertisement Nabin's first padyatra will commence at 11:00 AM from Lajpat Park in Bhagalpur, Bihar, and conclude at Seva Jyoti Chowk at 12:30 PM. Thereafter, the BJP National President will travel to Kolkata, West Bengal, where the 'Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao Padyatra' will commence at 3:00 PM from College Street. The padyatra will conclude at Dharmatala at 5:30 PM. According to an official release, the campaign of the Bharatiya Janata Party is a movement against the lies, deception, conspiracies and anarchy being spread by a desperate and disillusioned Opposition. With the resolve of 'Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao', every BJP karyakarta is reaching out to villages and households to expose the Opposition's false and fabricated narrative and apprise the people of the truth. Senior party leaders, State BJP presidents, and thousands of dedicated karyakartas are expected to participate in these padyatras being organised on Monday in Bhagalpur, Bihar, and Kolkata, West Bengal. Earlier on Sunday, leading a massive 'Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao' (Save Democracy, Eradicate Anarchy) padyatra in Rohtak, Haryana, Nitin Nabin launched a scathing attack on Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi and the Congress over the 1984 anti-Sikh riots and the 'Chalo Delhi' march to Ramlila Maidan. Addressing a large gathering of party workers and citizens at D-Park in Model Town following a march from Chhotu Ram Polytechnic Ground, Nabin slammed the Congress-led INDIA Bloc for organising protests on the anniversary of the 1984 anti-Sikh riots. He accused Congress of attacking democratic institutions out of frustration over electoral rejection, fostering dynastic rule, and undermining constitutional norms while posing as defenders of the Constitution. During the march, Nabin, along with other party leaders, paid homage at the statue of Mahatma Gandhi. Addressing the gathering, he questioned why the Congress had not apologised to the Sikh community for the 1984 violence and criticised Rahul Gandhi for participating in the Opposition's protest in Delhi. "The Congress party ought to have sought atonement for the sacrifices of them (Sikhs) forced upon people, the massacres, and the killings that took place; they should have offered an apology. Yet, today, they have taken to the streets to protest. I ask, on behalf of the people in this democracy, Rahul Gandhi: when our Sikh brethren were being slaughtered, when a full-scale massacre was unfolding, your father remarked that 'when a big tree falls, the earth shakes.' Because of that 'shaking of the earth,' the lives of so many of my Sikh brothers were extinguished. You should have felt remorse for this; you should have apologised," Nabin said. (ANI)

New Delhi: Independent MLCs Bansidhar Brijwasi, who won from Tirhut graduates' constituency, and Rahul Raj , who won from Saran teachers' constituency, joined BJP in the presence of senior party leaders on Saturday. Bihar BJP chief Sanjay Saraogi's social media post also mentioned that the two leaders have taken the party's membership. The Opposition termed their move a violation of the Tenth Schedule of the Constitution. It stated that an independent MLC cannot join any party; doing so will lead to the disqualification of their membership. Read more: Bihar MLC polls: RJD's Anil Jha declared elected, party's overall tally climbs to 17 "Two independents, Rahul Raj and Bansidhar Brijwasi , joined BJP on Saturday. They even displayed their joining slip to the media. This is a clear violation of the Tenth Schedule and Article 191(2) of the Constitution. RJD would approach the Chairman of the Bihar Legislative Council , seeking the disqualification of the two independent MLCs. The ball is now in the Chairman's court. We would also move the court for justice," RJD leader Manoj Jha told ET. Live Events Realising the faux pas, Brijwasi later said that he had not taken BJP membership, but had only extended support to it. Saraogi also deleted his social media post and replaced it with a new one, stating that the two independent MLCs had extended their support to BJP. "There is no question of them joining the party. They came to BJP office and we welcomed them. They have extended their support to BJP. There is nothing wrong with that. Independent MP Pappu Yadav shares stage with Congress. Has he joined Congress?
